title: The Mumford-Tate Conjecture for Abelian Varieties over Number Fields
exact_target: Do the connected arithmetic symmetries of an abelian variety's Tate module coincide with the symmetries predicted by its Hodge structure?

sources.citation: J.-P. Serre, Abelian l-Adic Representations and Elliptic Curves, Addison-Wesley, 1968.
